1module phys_grid
2!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3!
4! Purpose: Definition of physics computational horizontal grid.
5!
6! Method: Variables are private; interface routines used to extract
7! information for use in user code.
8!
9! Entry points:
10! phys_grid_init initialize chunk'ed data structure
11! phys_grid_initialized get physgrid_set flag
12!
13! phys_grid_defaultopts get default runtime options
14! phys_grid_setopts set runtime options
15!
16! get_chunk_indices_p get local chunk index range
17! get_ncols_p get number of columns for a given chunk
18! get_xxx_all_p get global indices, coordinates, or values
19! for a given chunk
20! get_xxx_vec_p get global indices, coordinates, or values
21! for a subset of the columns in a chunk
22! get_xxx_p get global indices, coordinates, or values
23! for a single column
24! where xxx is
25! area for column surface area (in radians squared)
26! gcol for global column index
27! lat for global latitude index
28! lon for global longitude index
29! rlat for latitude coordinate (in radians)
30! rlon for longitude coordinate (in radians)
31! wght for column integration weight
32!
33! scatter_field_to_chunk
34! distribute field
35! to decomposed chunk data structure
36! gather_chunk_to_field
37! reconstruct field
38! from decomposed chunk data structure
39!
40! read_chunk_from_field
41! read and distribute field
42! to decomposed chunk data structure
43! write_field_from_chunk
44! write field
45! from decomposed chunk data structure
46!
47! block_to_chunk_send_pters
48! return pointers into send buffer where data
49! from decomposed fields should
50! be copied to
51! block_to_chunk_recv_pters
52! return pointers into receive buffer where data
53! for decomposed chunk data structures should
54! be copied from
55! transpose_block_to_chunk
56! transpose buffer containing decomposed
57! fields to buffer
58! containing decomposed chunk data structures
59!
60! chunk_to_block_send_pters
61! return pointers into send buffer where data
62! from decomposed chunk data structures should
63! be copied to
64! chunk_to_block_recv_pters
65! return pointers into receive buffer where data
66! for decomposed fields should
67! be copied from
68! transpose_chunk_to_block
69! transpose buffer containing decomposed
70! chunk data structures to buffer
71! containing decomposed fields
72!
73! chunk_index identify whether index is for a latitude or
74! a chunk
75!
76! FOLLOWING ARE NO LONGER USED, AND ARE CURRENTLY COMMENTED OUT
77! get_gcol_owner_p get owner of column
78! for given global physics column index
79!
80! buff_to_chunk Copy from local buffer to local chunk data
81! structure. (Needed for cpl6.)
82!
83! chunk_to_buff Copy from local chunk data structure to
84! local buffer. (Needed for cpl6.)
85!
86! Author: Patrick Worley and John Drake
87!

249! Physics grid decomposition options:
250! -1: each chunk is a dynamics block
251! 0: chunk definitions and assignments do not require interprocess comm.
252! 1: chunk definitions and assignments do not require internode comm.
253! 2: chunk definitions and assignments may require communication between all processes
254! 3: chunk definitions and assignments only require communication with one other process
255! 4: concatenated blocks, no load balancing, no interprocess communication
256 integer, private, parameter :: min_lbal_opt = -1
257 integer, private, parameter :: max_lbal_opt = 5
258 integer, private, parameter :: def_lbal_opt = 1 ! default
259 integer, private :: lbal_opt = def_lbal_opt
260
261! Physics grid load balancing options:
262! 0: assign columns to chunks as single columns, wrap mapped across chunks
263! 1: use (day/night; north/south) twin algorithm to determine load-balanced pairs of
264! columns and assign columns to chunks in pairs, wrap mapped
265 integer, private, parameter :: min_twin_alg = 0
266 integer, private, parameter :: max_twin_alg = 1
267 integer, private, parameter :: def_twin_alg_lonlat = 1 ! default
268 integer, private, parameter :: def_twin_alg_unstructured = 0
269 integer, private :: twin_alg = def_twin_alg_lonlat
270
271! target number of chunks per thread
272 integer, private, parameter :: min_chunks_per_thread = 1
273 integer, private, parameter :: def_chunks_per_thread = &
274 min_chunks_per_thread ! default
275 integer, private :: chunks_per_thread = def_chunks_per_thread
276
277! Dynamics/physics transpose method for nonlocal load-balance:
278! -1: use "0" if max_nproc_smpx and nproc_busy_d are both > npes/2; otherwise use "1"
279! 0: use mpi_alltoallv
280! 1: use point-to-point MPI-1 two-sided implementation
281! 2: use point-to-point MPI-2 one-sided implementation if supported,
282! otherwise use MPI-1 implementation
283! 3: use Co-Array Fortran implementation if supported,
284! otherwise use MPI-1 implementation
285! 11-13: use mod_comm, choosing any of several methods internal to mod_comm.
286! The method within mod_comm (denoted mod_method) has possible values 0,1,2 and
287! is set according to mod_method = phys_alltoall - modmin_alltoall, where
288! modmin_alltoall is 11.
289 integer, private, parameter :: min_alltoall = -1
290 integer, private, parameter :: max_alltoall = 3
291# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
292 integer, private, parameter :: modmin_alltoall = 11
293 integer, private, parameter :: modmax_alltoall = 13
294# endif
295 integer, private, parameter :: def_alltoall = -1 ! default
296 integer, private :: phys_alltoall = def_alltoall

601 chunks(cid)%gcol(ncols) = curgcol_d
602 chunks(cid)%lat(ncols) = lat_p(curgcol_d)
603 chunks(cid)%lon(ncols) = lon_p(curgcol_d)
604 endif
605 enddo
606 chunks(cid)%ncols = ncols
607 enddo
608
609 ! Clean-up
61000 deallocate( cdex )
61100 deallocate( lat_p )
61200 deallocate( lon_p )
613
614 !
615 ! Specify parallel decomposition
616 !
61700 do cid=1,nchunks
618#if (defined SPMD)
61900 p = get_block_owner_d(cid+firstblock-1)
620#else
621 p = 0
622#endif
623 chunks(cid)%owner = p
624 npchunks(p) = npchunks(p) + 1
625 gs_col_num(p) = gs_col_num(p) + chunks(cid)%ncols
626 enddo
627 !
628 ! Set flag indicating columns in physics and dynamics
629 ! decompositions reside on the same processes
630 !
63100 local_dp_map = .true.
632 !
633 else
634 !
635 ! Option == 0: split local blocks into chunks,
636 ! while attempting to create load-balanced chunks.
637 ! Does not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
638 ! (default)
639 ! Option == 1: split SMP-local blocks into chunks,
640 ! while attempting to create load-balanced chunks.
641 ! Does not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
642 ! Option == 2: load balance chunks with respect to diurnal and
643 ! seaonsal cycles and wth respect to latitude,
644 ! and assign chunks to processes
645 ! in a way that attempts to minimize communication costs
646 ! Option == 3: divide processes into pairs and split
647 ! blocks assigned to these pairs into
648 ! chunks, attempting to create load-balanced chunks.
649 ! The process pairs are chosen to maximize load balancing
650 ! opportunities.
651 ! Does not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
652 ! Option == 4: concatenate local blocks, then
653 ! divide into chunks.
654 ! Does not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
655 ! Option == 5: split indiviudal blocks into chunks,
656 ! assigning columns using block ordering
657 !
658 !
659 ! Allocate and initialize chunks data structure, then
660 ! assign chunks to processes.
661 !
662512512 call create_chunks(lbal_opt, chunks_per_thread)
663
664 ! Early clean-up, to minimize memory high water mark
6655121536 deallocate( lat_p )
6665121536 deallocate( lon_p )
6675121536 deallocate( latlon_to_dyn_gcol_map )
668512512 if (twin_alg .eq. 1) deallocate( lonlat_to_dyn_gcol_map )
669512512 if (twin_alg .eq. 1) deallocate( clon_p_cnt )
6705121024 if ((twin_alg .eq. 1) .or. (lbal_opt .eq. 3)) deallocate( clat_p_cnt )
671
672 !
673 ! Determine whether dynamics and physics decompositions
674 ! are colocated, not requiring any interprocess communication
675 ! in the coupling.
676512512 local_dp_map = .true.
677524288524288 do cid=1,nchunks
67870789127603200 do i=1,chunks(cid)%ncols
67970789127078912 curgcol_d = chunks(cid)%gcol(i)
680707891214157824 block_cnt = get_gcol_block_cnt_d(curgcol_d)
68170789127078912 call get_gcol_block_d(curgcol_d,block_cnt,blockids,bcids)
682707891214157824 do jb=1,block_cnt
683707891214157824 owner_d = get_block_owner_d(blockids(jb))
684 if (owner_d .ne. chunks(cid)%owner) then
68566283526628352 local_dp_map = .false.
686 endif
687 enddo
688 enddo
689 enddo
690 endif
691 !
692 ! Allocate and initialize data structures for gather/scatter
693 !
6945123072 allocate( pgcols(1:ngcols_p) )
6955123072 allocate( gs_col_offset(0:npes) )
6965123072 allocate( pchunkid(0:npes) )
697
698 ! Initialize pchunkid and gs_col_offset by summing
699 ! number of chunks and columns per process, respectively
700512512 pchunkid(0) = 0
701 gs_col_offset(0) = 0
702261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
703 pchunkid(p) = pchunkid(p-1) + npchunks(p-1)
704 gs_col_offset(p) = gs_col_offset(p-1) + gs_col_num(p-1)
705 enddo
706
707 ! Determine local ordering via "process id" bin sort
708524288524800 do cid=1,nchunks
709524288524288 p = chunks(cid)%owner
710 pchunkid(p) = pchunkid(p) + 1
711
712 chunks(cid)%lcid = pchunkid(p) + lastblock
713
714 curgcol = gs_col_offset(p)
71570789127078912 do i=1,chunks(cid)%ncols
716 curgcol = curgcol + 1
717 pgcols(curgcol)%chunk = cid
718 pgcols(curgcol)%ccol = i
719 enddo
720 gs_col_offset(p) = curgcol
721 enddo
722
723 ! Reinitialize pchunkid and gs_col_offset (for real)
724512512 pchunkid(0) = 1
725 gs_col_offset(0) = 1
726261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
727 pchunkid(p) = pchunkid(p-1) + npchunks(p-1)
728 gs_col_offset(p) = gs_col_offset(p-1) + gs_col_num(p-1)
729 enddo
730512512 pchunkid(npes) = pchunkid(npes-1) + npchunks(npes-1)
731 gs_col_offset(npes) = gs_col_offset(npes-1) + gs_col_num(npes-1)
732
733 ! Save local information
734 ! (Local chunk index range chosen so that it does not overlap
735 ! {begblock,...,endblock})
736 !
737 nlcols = gs_col_num(iam)
738 nlchunks = npchunks(iam)
739 begchunk = pchunkid(iam) + lastblock
740 endchunk = pchunkid(iam+1) + lastblock - 1
741 !
7425122560 allocate( lchunks(begchunk:endchunk) )
743524288524800 do cid=1,nchunks
744524288524288 if (chunks(cid)%owner == iam) then
74510241024 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
746 lchunks(lcid)%ncols = chunks(cid)%ncols
747 lchunks(lcid)%cid = cid
7481382613826 do i=1,chunks(cid)%ncols
749 lchunks(lcid)%gcol(i) = chunks(cid)%gcol(i)
750 enddo
751 endif
752 enddo
753
7545121536 deallocate( pchunkid )
7555121536 deallocate( npchunks )
756 !
757 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
758 !
759 ! Initialize physics grid, using dynamics grid
760 ! b) column area and integration weight
761
7625123072 allocate( area_d(1:ngcols) )
7635123072 allocate( wght_d(1:ngcols) )
76470789127079936 area_d = 0.0_r8
76570789127079936 wght_d = 0.0_r8
766
7675123072 call get_horiz_grid_d(ngcols, area_d_out=area_d, wght_d_out=wght_d)
768
769
77070789127080448 if ( abs(sum(area_d) - 4.0_r8*pi) > 1.e-10_r8 ) then
77100 write(iulog,*) ' ERROR: sum of areas on globe does not equal 4*pi'
77200 write(iulog,*) ' sum of areas = ', sum(area_d), sum(area_d)-4.0_r8*pi
77300 call endrun('phys_grid')
774 end if
775
77670789127080448 if ( abs(sum(wght_d) - 4.0_r8*pi) > 1.e-10_r8 ) then
77700 write(iulog,*) ' ERROR: sum of integration weights on globe does not equal 4*pi'
77800 write(iulog,*) ' sum of weights = ', sum(wght_d), sum(wght_d)-4.0_r8*pi
77900 call endrun('phys_grid')
780 end if
781
78210241536 do lcid=begchunk,endchunk
7831382614850 do i=1,lchunks(lcid)%ncols
784 lchunks(lcid)%area(i) = area_d(lchunks(lcid)%gcol(i))
785 lchunks(lcid)%wght(i) = wght_d(lchunks(lcid)%gcol(i))
786 enddo
787 enddo
788
7895121536 deallocate( area_d )
7905121536 deallocate( wght_d )
791
792512512 if (.not. local_dp_map) then
793 !
794 ! allocate and initialize data structures for transposes
795 !
7965123072 allocate( btofc_blk_num(0:npes-1) )
797262144263168 btofc_blk_num = 0
7985123072 allocate( btofc_blk_offset(firstblock:lastblock) )
799786432786944 do jb = firstblock,lastblock
800 nullify( btofc_blk_offset(jb)%pter )
801 enddo
802 !
803512512 glbcnt = 0
804 curcnt = 0
805 curp = 0
80670789127078912 do curgcol=1,ngcols_p
80770789127078912 cid = pgcols(curgcol)%chunk
808 i = pgcols(curgcol)%ccol
809 owner_p = chunks(cid)%owner
81070789127340544 do while (curp < owner_p)
811 btofc_blk_num(curp) = curcnt
812 curcnt = 0
813 curp = curp + 1
814 enddo
81570789127078912 curgcol_d = chunks(cid)%gcol(i)
816707891214157824 block_cnt = get_gcol_block_cnt_d(curgcol_d)
81770789127078912 call get_gcol_block_d(curgcol_d,block_cnt,blockids,bcids)
818707891214157824 do jb = 1,block_cnt
819707891214157824 owner_d = get_block_owner_d(blockids(jb))
820 if (iam == owner_d) then
8211382641478 if (.not. associated(btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%pter)) then
82215363072 blksiz = get_block_gcol_cnt_d(blockids(jb))
82315363072 numlvl = get_block_lvl_cnt_d(blockids(jb),bcids(jb))
824 btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%ncols = blksiz
825 btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%nlvls = numlvl
826153610752 allocate( btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%pter(blksiz,numlvl) )
827 endif
828428606442432 do k=1,btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%nlvls
829 btofc_blk_offset(blockids(jb))%pter(bcids(jb),k) = glbcnt
830 curcnt = curcnt + 1
831 glbcnt = glbcnt + 1
832 enddo
833 endif
834 enddo
835 enddo
836512512 btofc_blk_num(curp) = curcnt
837 block_buf_nrecs = glbcnt
838 !
8395122560 allocate( btofc_chk_num(0:npes-1) )
840262144263168 btofc_chk_num = 0
8415123072 allocate( btofc_chk_offset(begchunk:endchunk) )
84210241536 do lcid=begchunk,endchunk
84310241024 ncols = lchunks(lcid)%ncols
844 btofc_chk_offset(lcid)%ncols = ncols
845 btofc_chk_offset(lcid)%nlvls = pver+1
84610245120 allocate( btofc_chk_offset(lcid)%pter(ncols,pver+1) )
847 enddo
848 !
849512512 curcnt = 0
850 glbcnt = 0
851262144262144 do p=0,npes-1
85270789127341056 do curgcol=gs_col_offset(iam),gs_col_offset(iam+1)-1
85370789127078912 cid = pgcols(curgcol)%chunk
854 owner_p = chunks(cid)%owner
855 if (iam == owner_p) then
85670789127078912 i = pgcols(curgcol)%ccol
857 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
858 curgcol_d = chunks(cid)%gcol(i)
859707891214157824 block_cnt = get_gcol_block_cnt_d(curgcol_d)
86070789127078912 call get_gcol_block_d(curgcol_d,block_cnt,blockids,bcids)
861707891214157824 do jb = 1,block_cnt
862707891214157824 owner_d = get_block_owner_d(blockids(jb))
863 if (p == owner_d) then
8641382627652 numlvl = get_block_lvl_cnt_d(blockids(jb),bcids(jb))
8651382613826 call get_block_levels_d(blockids(jb),bcids(jb),numlvl,levels)
866428606442432 do k=1,numlvl
867 btofc_chk_offset(lcid)%pter(i,levels(k)+1) = glbcnt
868 curcnt = curcnt + 1
869 glbcnt = glbcnt + 1
870 enddo
871 endif
872 enddo
873 endif
874 enddo
875 btofc_chk_num(p) = curcnt
876 curcnt = 0
877 enddo
878512512 chunk_buf_nrecs = glbcnt
879 !
880 ! Precompute swap partners and number of steps in point-to-point
881 ! implementations of alltoall algorithm.
882 ! First, determine number of swaps.
883 !
884 dp_coup_steps = 0
885261632262656 do i=1,ceil2(npes)-1
886261632523264 p = pair(npes,i,iam)
887 if (p >= 0) then
888261632515658 if ((btofc_blk_num(p) > 0 .or. btofc_chk_num(p) > 0)) then
8891364013640 dp_coup_steps = dp_coup_steps + 1
890 end if
891 end if
892 end do
893 !
894 ! Second, determine swap partners.
895 !
8965123072 allocate( dp_coup_proc(dp_coup_steps) )
897512512 dp_coup_steps = 0
898261632262656 do i=1,ceil2(npes)-1
899261632523264 p = pair(npes,i,iam)
900 if (p >= 0) then
901261632515658 if ((btofc_blk_num(p) > 0 .or. btofc_chk_num(p) > 0)) then
9021364013640 dp_coup_steps = dp_coup_steps + 1
903 dp_coup_proc(dp_coup_steps) = p
904 end if
905 end if
906 end do
907 !
908 endif
909
910 ! Final clean-up
9115121536 deallocate( gs_col_offset )
912 ! (if eliminate get_lon_xxx, can also deallocate
913 ! clat_p_idx, and grid_latlon?))
914
915 !
916512512 physgrid_set = .true. ! Set flag indicating physics grid is now set
917 !
918 if (masterproc) then
919111 write(iulog,*) 'PHYS_GRID_INIT: Using PCOLS=',pcols, &
920 ' phys_loadbalance=',lbal_opt, &
921 ' phys_twin_algorithm=',twin_alg, &
922 ' phys_alltoall=',phys_alltoall, &
923 ' chunks_per_thread=',chunks_per_thread
924 endif
925 !
926
927512512 call t_stopf("phys_grid_init")
928512512 call t_adj_detailf(+2)
929 return
9305123584 end subroutine phys_grid_init

934subroutine phys_grid_find_col(lat, lon, owner, lcid, icol)
935
936 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
937 !
938 ! Purpose: Find the global column closest to the point specified by lat
939 ! and lon. Return indices of owning process, local chunk, and
940 ! column.
941 !
942 ! Authors: Phil Rasch / Patrick Worley / B. Eaton
943 !
944 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
945
946 real(r8), intent(in) :: lat, lon ! requested location in degrees
947 integer, intent(out) :: owner ! rank of chunk owner
948 integer, intent(out) :: lcid ! local chunk index
949 integer, intent(out) :: icol ! column index within the chunk
950
951 ! local
952 real(r8) dist2 ! the distance (in radians**2 from lat, lon)
953 real(r8) distmin ! the distance (in radians**2 from closest column)
954 real(r8) latr, lonr ! lat, lon (in radians) of requested location
955 real(r8) clat, clon ! lat, lon (in radians) of column being tested
956 real(r8) const
957
958 integer i
959 integer cid
960 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
961
962 ! Check that input lat and lon are in valid range
963 if (lon < 0.0_r8 .or. lon >= 360._r8 .or. &
964 lat < -90._r8 .or. lat > 90._r8) then
965 if (masterproc) then
966 write(iulog,*) &
967 'phys_grid_find_col: ERROR: lon must satisfy 0.<=lon<360. and lat must satisfy -90<=lat<=90.'
968 write(iulog,*) &
969 'input lon=', lon, ' input lat=', lat
970 endif
971 call endrun('phys_grid_find_col: input ERROR')
972 end if
973
974 const = 180._r8/pi ! degrees per radian
975 latr = lat/const ! to radians
976 lonr = lon/const ! to radians
977
978 owner = -999
979 lcid = -999
980 icol = -999
981 distmin = 1.e10_r8
982
983 ! scan all chunks for closest point to lat, lon
984 do cid = 1, nchunks
985 do i = 1, chunks(cid)%ncols
986 clat = clat_p(chunks(cid)%lat(i))
987 clon = clon_p(chunks(cid)%lon(i))
988 dist2 = (clat-latr)**2 + (clon-lonr)**2
989 if (dist2 < distmin ) then
990 distmin = dist2
991 owner = chunks(cid)%owner
992 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
993 icol = i
994 endif
995 enddo
996 end do
997
998end subroutine phys_grid_find_col
999
1000!========================================================================
1001
1002subroutine phys_grid_find_cols(lat, lon, nclosest, owner, lcid, icol, distmin, mlats, mlons)
1003
1004 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1005 !
1006 ! Purpose: Find the global columns closest to the point specified by lat
1007 ! and lon. Return indices of owning process, local chunk, and
1008 ! column.
1009 !
1010 ! Authors: Phil Rasch / Patrick Worley / B. Eaton
1011 !
1012 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1013 use physconst, only : rearth
1014
1015 real(r8), intent(in) :: lat, lon ! requested location in degrees
1016 integer, intent(in) :: nclosest ! number of closest points to find
1017 integer, intent(out) :: owner(nclosest) ! rank of chunk owner
1018 integer, intent(out) :: lcid(nclosest) ! local chunk index
1019 integer, intent(out) :: icol(nclosest) ! column index within the chunk
1020 real(r8),intent(out) :: distmin(nclosest) ! the distance (m) of the closest column(s)
1021 real(r8),intent(out) :: mlats(nclosest) ! the latitude of the closest column(s)
1022 real(r8),intent(out) :: mlons(nclosest) ! the longitude of the closest column(s)
1023
1024 ! local
1025 real(r8) dist2 ! the distance (in radians**2 from lat, lon)
1026 real(r8) latr, lonr ! lat, lon (in radians) of requested location
1027 real(r8) clat, clon ! lat, lon (in radians) of column being tested
1028 real(r8) const
1029
1030 integer i, j
1031 integer cid
1032 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1033
1034 ! Check that input lat and lon are in valid range
1035 if (lon < 0.0_r8 .or. lon >= 360._r8 .or. &
1036 lat < -90._r8 .or. lat > 90._r8) then
1037 if (masterproc) then
1038 write(iulog,*) &
1039 'phys_grid_find_cols: ERROR: lon must satisfy 0.<=lon<360. and lat must satisfy -90<=lat<=90.'
1040 write(iulog,*) &
1041 'input lon=', lon, ' input lat=', lat
1042 endif
1043 call endrun('phys_grid_find_cols: input ERROR')
1044 end if
1045
1046 const = 180._r8/pi ! degrees per radian
1047 latr = lat/const ! to radians
1048 lonr = lon/const ! to radians
1049
1050 owner(:) = -999
1051 lcid(:) = -999
1052 icol(:) = -999
1053 mlats(:) = -999
1054 mlons(:) = -999
1055 distmin(:) = 1.e10_r8
1056
1057 ! scan all chunks for closest point to lat, lon
1058 do cid = 1, nchunks
1059 do i = 1, chunks(cid)%ncols
1060 clat = clat_p(chunks(cid)%lat(i))
1061 clon = clon_p(chunks(cid)%lon(i))
1062 dist2 = acos(sin(latr) * sin(clat) + cos(latr) * cos(clat) * cos(clon - lonr)) * rearth
1063
1064 do j = nclosest, 1, -1
1065 if (dist2 < distmin(j)) then
1066
1067 if (j < nclosest) then
1068 distmin(j+1) = distmin(j)
1069 owner(j+1) = owner(j)
1070 lcid(j+1) = lcid(j)
1071 icol(j+1) = icol(j)
1072 mlats(j+1) = mlats(j)
1073 mlons(j+1) = mlons(j)
1074 end if
1075
1076 distmin(j) = dist2
1077 owner(j) = chunks(cid)%owner
1078 lcid(j) = chunks(cid)%lcid
1079 icol(j) = i
1080 mlats(j) = clat * const
1081 mlons(j) = clon * const
1082 else
1083 exit
1084 end if
1085 enddo
1086 enddo
1087 end do
1088
1089end subroutine phys_grid_find_cols

110510241024 phys_grid_initialized = physgrid_set

1114 phys_twin_algorithm_out, &
1115 phys_alltoall_out, &
1116 phys_chnk_per_thd_out )
1117!-----------------------------------------------------------------------

1131!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
11325121536 if ( present(phys_loadbalance_out) ) then

1134 endif

11365121024 if (dycore_is('UNSTRUCTURED')) then
1137512512 phys_twin_algorithm_out = def_twin_alg_unstructured
1138 else
113900 phys_twin_algorithm_out = def_twin_alg_lonlat
1140 endif
1141 endif
11425121536 if ( present(phys_alltoall_out) ) then

1147 endif
1148512512 end subroutine phys_grid_defaultopts

1152512512 subroutine phys_grid_setopts(phys_loadbalance_in, &
1153 phys_twin_algorithm_in, &
1154 phys_alltoall_in, &
1155 phys_chnk_per_thd_in )
1156!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1157! Purpose: Set runtime options
1158! Author: Tom Henderson
1159!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1160 use spmd_utils, only: phys_mirror_decomp_req
1161#if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
1162 use mod_comm, only: phys_transpose_mod
1163#endif
1164!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
1165 ! physics load balancing option
1166 integer, intent(in), optional :: phys_loadbalance_in
1167 ! option to use load balanced column pairs
1168 integer, intent(in), optional :: phys_twin_algorithm_in
1169 ! alltoall option
1170 integer, intent(in), optional :: phys_alltoall_in
1171 ! number of chunks per thread
1172 integer, intent(in), optional :: phys_chnk_per_thd_in
1173!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
11745121536 if ( present(phys_loadbalance_in) ) then
1175512512 lbal_opt = phys_loadbalance_in
1176512512 if ((lbal_opt < min_lbal_opt).or.(lbal_opt > max_lbal_opt)) then
117700 if (masterproc) then
117800 write(iulog,*) &
1179 'PHYS_GRID_SETOPTS: ERROR: phys_loadbalance=', &
1180 phys_loadbalance_in, &
1181 ' is out of range. It must be between ', &
1182 min_lbal_opt,' and ',max_lbal_opt
1183 endif
118400 call endrun
1185 endif
1186512512 if (lbal_opt .eq. 3) then
118700 phys_mirror_decomp_req = .true.
1188 else
1189512512 phys_mirror_decomp_req = .false.
1190 endif
1191 endif
1192!
11935121536 if ( present(phys_twin_algorithm_in) ) then
1194512512 twin_alg = phys_twin_algorithm_in
1195 if ((twin_alg < min_twin_alg).or.(twin_alg > max_twin_alg)) then
119600 if (masterproc) then
119700 write(iulog,*) &
1198 'PHYS_GRID_SETOPTS: ERROR: phys_twin_algorithm=', &
1199 phys_twin_algorithm_in, &
1200 ' is out of range. It must be between ', &
1201 min_twin_alg,' and ',max_twin_alg
1202 endif
120300 call endrun
1204 endif
1205 endif
1206!
12075121536 if ( present(phys_alltoall_in) ) then
1208512512 phys_alltoall = phys_alltoall_in
1209512512 if (((phys_alltoall .lt. min_alltoall) .or. &
1210 (phys_alltoall .gt. max_alltoall)) &
1211# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
1212 .and. &
1213 ((phys_alltoall .lt. modmin_alltoall) .or. &
1214 (phys_alltoall .gt. modmax_alltoall)) &
1215# endif
1216 ) then
121700 if (masterproc) then
121800 write(iulog,*) &
1219 'PHYS_GRID_SET_OPTS: ERROR: phys_alltoall=', &
1220 phys_alltoall_in, &
1221 ' is out of range. It must be between ', &
1222 min_alltoall,' and ',max_alltoall
1223 endif
122400 call endrun
1225 endif
1226#if defined(SPMD)
1227# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
1228 phys_transpose_mod = phys_alltoall
1229# endif
1230#endif
1231 endif
1232!
12335121536 if ( present(phys_chnk_per_thd_in) ) then
1234512512 chunks_per_thread = phys_chnk_per_thd_in
1235 if (chunks_per_thread < min_chunks_per_thread) then
123600 if (masterproc) then
123700 write(iulog,*) &
1238 'PHYS_GRID_SETOPTS: ERROR: phys_chnk_per_thd=',&
1239 phys_chnk_per_thd_in, &
1240 ' is too small. It must not be smaller than ', &
1241 min_chunks_per_thread
1242 endif
124300 call endrun
1244 endif
1245 endif
1246512512 end subroutine phys_grid_setopts

14765222452224 subroutine get_lon_all_p(lcid, londim, lons)
1477!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1478!
1479! Purpose:
1480! Was: Return all global longitude indices for chunk
1481! Now: Return all longitude offsets (+1) for chunk. These are offsets
1482! in ordered list of global columns from first
1483! column with given latitude to column with given latitude
1484! and longitude. This corresponds to the usual longitude indices
1485! for full and reduced lon/lat grids.
1486!
1487! Method:
1488!
1489! Author: Patrick Worley
1490!
1491!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1492 use ppgrid
1493!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
1494 integer, intent(in) :: lcid ! local chunk id
1495 integer, intent(in) :: londim ! declared size of output array
1496
1497 integer, intent(out) :: lons(londim) ! array of global longitude
1498 ! indices
1499
1500!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
1501 integer :: i ! loop index
1502 integer :: lat ! latitude index
1503 integer :: cid ! global chunk id
1504 integer :: gcol ! global column id in latlon
1505 ! ordering
1506
1507!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1508 cid = lchunks(lcid)%cid
1509705126705126 do i=1,chunks(cid)%ncols
1510 lat = chunks(cid)%lat(i)
1511 gcol = dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(chunks(cid)%gcol(i))
1512 lons(i) = (gcol - clat_p_idx(lat)) + 1
1513 enddo
1514
1515 return
15165222452224 end subroutine get_lon_all_p

1914! subroutine buff_to_chunk(fdim,mdim,lbuff,localchunks)
1915!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1916!
1917! Purpose: Copy from local buffer
1918! to local chunk data structure.
1919! Needed for cpl6.
1920!
1921! Method:
1922!
1923! Author: Pat Worley and Robert Jacob
1924!
1925!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1926!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
1927! integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! declared length of first lbuff dimension
1928! integer, intent(in) :: mdim ! declared length of middle lbuff dimension
1929! real(r8), intent(in) :: lbuff(fdim, mdim) ! local lon/lat buffer
1930!
1931! real(r8), intent(out):: localchunks(pcols,mdim,begchunk:endchunk) ! local chunks
1932!
1933!
1934!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
1935! integer :: i,j,m,n ! loop indices
1936!
1937! integer, save :: numcols = 0
1938! integer, allocatable, save :: columnid(:), chunkid(:)
1939!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1940!
1941! if (numcols .eq. 0) then
1942! n = 0
1943! do i=1,ngcols
1944! if (dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(i) .ne. -1) then
1945! if(chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%owner .eq. iam) then
1946! n = n + 1
1947! endif
1948! endif
1949! enddo
1950! allocate(columnid(1:n))
1951! allocate(chunkid(1:n))
1952!
1953! n = 0
1954! do i=1,ngcols
1955! if (dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(i) .ne. -1) then
1956! if(chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%owner .eq. iam) then
1957! n = n + 1
1958! columnid(n) = knuhcs(i)%col
1959! chunkid(n) = chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%lcid
1960! endif
1961! endif
1962! end do
1963!
1964! numcols = n
1965! endif
1966!

1981 subroutine scatter_field_to_chunk(fdim,mdim,ldim, &
1982 hdim1d,globalfield,localchunks)
1983!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1984!
1985! Purpose: Distribute field
1986! to decomposed chunk data structure
1987!
1988! Method:
1989!
1990! Author: Patrick Worley
1991!
1992
1993!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
1994 integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! declared length of first dimension
1995 integer, intent(in) :: mdim ! declared length of middle dimension
1996 integer, intent(in) :: ldim ! declared length of last dimension
1997 integer, intent(in) :: hdim1d ! declared first horizontal index
1998 ! dimension
1999 real(r8), intent(in) :: globalfield(fdim,hdim1d,mdim,hdim2_d,ldim)
2000 ! global field
2001
2002 real(r8), intent(out):: localchunks(fdim,pcols,mdim, &
2003 begchunk:endchunk,ldim)
2004 ! local chunks
2005
2006!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
2007 integer :: f,i,m,l,p ! loop indices
2008 integer :: cid ! global chunk id
2009 integer :: lcid ! local chunk id
2010 integer :: lid ! local column index
2011 integer :: gcol ! global column index
2012 integer :: h1 ! first horizontal dimension index
2013 integer :: h2 ! second horizontal dimension index
2014
2015#if ( defined SPMD )
2016 real(r8) gfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,ngcols)
2017 ! vector to be scattered
2018 real(r8) lfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,nlcols)
2019 ! local component of scattered
2020 ! vector
2021 integer :: displs(0:npes-1) ! scatter displacements
2022 integer :: sndcnts(0:npes-1) ! scatter send counts
2023 integer :: recvcnt ! scatter receive count
2024 integer :: beglcol ! beginning index for local columns
2025 ! in global column ordering
2026#endif
2027
2028!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2029 if (hdim1d < hdim1_d) then
2030 write(iulog,*) __FILE__,__LINE__,hdim1d,hdim1_d
2031 call endrun ('SCATTER_FIELD_TO_CHUNK error: hdim1d < hdim1_d')
2032 endif
2033 localchunks(:,:,:,:,:) = 0
2034#if ( defined SPMD )
2035 displs(0) = 0
2036 sndcnts(0) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(0)
2037 beglcol = 0
2038 do p=1,npes-1
2039 displs(p) = displs(p-1) + sndcnts(p-1)
2040 sndcnts(p) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(p)
2041 if (p <= iam) then
2042 beglcol = beglcol + gs_col_num(p-1)
2043 endif
2044 enddo
2045 recvcnt = fdim*mdim*ldim*nlcols
2046
2047 if (masterproc) then
2048
2049! copy field into global (process-ordered) chunked data structure
2050
2051 do l=1,ldim
2052!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR
2053!DIR$ PREFERSTREAM
2054!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2055 do i=1,ngcols_p
2056 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2057 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2058 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2059 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2060 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2061 do m=1,mdim
2062 do f=1,fdim
2063 gfield_p(f,m,l,i) = &
2064 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l)
2065 end do
2066 end do
2067 end do
2068 end do
2069 endif
2070
2071! scatter to other processes
2072! (pgcols ordering consistent with begchunk:endchunk
2073! local ordering)
2074
2075 call t_barrierf('sync_scat_ftoc', mpicom)
2076 call mpiscatterv(gfield_p, sndcnts, displs, mpir8, &
2077 lfield_p, recvcnt, mpir8, 0, mpicom)
2078
2079! copy into local chunked data structure
2080
2081!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR
2082!DIR$ PREFERSTREAM
2083!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2084 do i=1,nlcols
2085 cid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%chunk
2086 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2087 lid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%ccol
2088 do l=1,ldim
2089 do m=1,mdim
2090 do f=1,fdim
2091 localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l) = &
2092 lfield_p(f, m, l, i)
2093 end do
2094 end do
2095 end do
2096 end do
2097#else
2098
2099! copy field into chunked data structure
2100! (pgcol ordering chosen to reflect begchunk:endchunk
2101! local ordering)
2102
2103 do l=1,ldim
2104!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR
2105!DIR$ PREFERSTREAM
2106!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2107 do i=1,ngcols_p
2108 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2109 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2110 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2111 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2112 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2113 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2114 do m=1,mdim
2115 do f=1,fdim
2116 localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l) = &
2117 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l)
2118 end do
2119 end do
2120 end do
2121 end do
2122
2123#endif
2124
2125 return
2126 end subroutine scatter_field_to_chunk

2417! subroutine chunk_to_buff(fdim,mdim,localchunks,lbuff)
2418!
2419!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2420!
2421! Purpose: Copy from local chunk data structure
2422! to local buffer. Needed for cpl6.
2423! (local = assigned to same process)
2424!
2425! Method:
2426!
2427! Author: Pat Worley and Robert Jacob
2428!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2429!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
2430! integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! declared length of first lbuff dimension
2431! integer, intent(in) :: mdim ! declared length of middle lbuff dimension
2432! real(r8), intent(in):: localchunks(pcols,mdim, begchunk:endchunk) ! local chunks
2433!
2434! real(r8), intent(out) :: lbuff(fdim,mdim) ! local buff
2435!
2436!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
2437! integer :: i,j,m,n ! loop indices
2438!
2439! integer, save :: numcols = 0
2440! integer, allocatable, save :: columnid(:), chunkid(:)
2441!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2442!
2443! if (numcols .eq. 0) then
2444! n = 0
2445! do i=1,ngcols
2446! if (dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(i) .ne. -1) then
2447! if(chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%owner .eq. iam) then
2448! n = n + 1
2449! endif
2450! endif
2451! enddo
2452! allocate(columnid(1:n))
2453! allocate(chunkid(1:n))
2454!
2455! n = 0
2456! do i=1,ngcols
2457! if (dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(i) .ne. -1) then
2458! if(chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%owner .eq. iam) then
2459! n = n + 1
2460! columnid(n) = knuhcs(i)%col
2461! chunkid(n) = chunks(knuhcs(i)%chunkid)%lcid
2462! endif
2463! endif
2464! end do
2465!
2466! numcols = n
2467! endif
2468!
2469! if (numcols .gt. fdim) call endrun('chunk_to_buff')
2470! do m=1,mdim
2471!dir$ concurrent
2472!dir$ prefervector, preferstream
2473! do n = 1, numcols
2474! lbuff(n,m) = localchunks(columnid(n),m,chunkid(n))
2475! end do
2476! end do
2477!
2478! return
2479! end subroutine chunk_to_buff
2480!

2484 subroutine gather_chunk_to_field(fdim,mdim,ldim, &
2485 hdim1d,localchunks,globalfield)
2486
2487!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2488!
2489! Purpose: Reconstruct field
2490! from decomposed chunk data structure
2491!
2492! Method:
2493!
2494! Author: Patrick Worley
2495!
2496!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2497#if ( defined SPMD )
2498 use spmd_utils, only: fc_gatherv
2499#endif
2500!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
2501 integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! declared length of first dimension
2502 integer, intent(in) :: mdim ! declared length of middle dimension
2503 integer, intent(in) :: ldim ! declared length of last dimension
2504 integer, intent(in) :: hdim1d ! declared first horizontal index
2505 ! dimension
2506 real(r8), intent(in):: localchunks(fdim,pcols,mdim, &
2507 begchunk:endchunk,ldim)
2508 ! local chunks
2509
2510 real(r8), intent(out) :: globalfield(fdim,hdim1d,mdim,hdim2_d,ldim)
2511 ! global field
2512
2513!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
2514 integer :: f,i,m,l,p ! loop indices
2515 integer :: cid ! global chunk id
2516 integer :: lcid ! local chunk id
2517 integer :: lid ! local column index
2518 integer :: gcol ! global column index
2519 integer :: h1 ! first horizontal dimension index
2520 integer :: h2 ! second horizontal dimension index
2521
2522#if ( defined SPMD )
2523 real(r8) gfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,ngcols)
2524 ! vector to be gathered
2525 real(r8) lfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,nlcols)
2526 ! local component of gather
2527 ! vector
2528 integer :: displs(0:npes-1) ! gather displacements
2529 integer :: rcvcnts(0:npes-1) ! gather receive count
2530 integer :: sendcnt ! gather send counts
2531 integer :: beglcol ! beginning index for local columns
2532 ! in global column ordering
2533#endif
2534
2535!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2536 if (hdim1d < hdim1_d) then
2537 call endrun ('GATHER_CHUNK_TO_FIELD error: hdim1d < hdim1_d')
2538 endif
2539#if ( defined SPMD )
2540 displs(0) = 0
2541 rcvcnts(0) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(0)
2542 beglcol = 0
2543 do p=1,npes-1
2544 displs(p) = displs(p-1) + rcvcnts(p-1)
2545 rcvcnts(p) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(p)
2546 if (p <= iam) then
2547 beglcol = beglcol + gs_col_num(p-1)
2548 endif
2549 enddo
2550 sendcnt = fdim*mdim*ldim*nlcols
2551
2552! copy into local gather data structure
2553
2554 do l=1,ldim
2555!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2556!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2557 do i=1,nlcols
2558 cid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%chunk
2559 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2560 lid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%ccol
2561 do m=1,mdim
2562 do f=1,fdim
2563 lfield_p(f, m, l, i) = &
2564 localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l)
2565 end do
2566 end do
2567 end do
2568 end do
2569
2570! gather from other processes
2571
2572 call t_barrierf('sync_gath_ctof', mpicom)
2573 call fc_gatherv(lfield_p, sendcnt, mpir8, &
2574 gfield_p, rcvcnts, displs, mpir8, 0, mpicom)
2575
2576 if (masterproc) then
2577
2578! copy gathered columns into lon/lat field
2579
2580!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2581!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2582 do i=1,ngcols_p
2583 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2584 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2585 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2586 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2587 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2588 do l=1,ldim
2589 do m=1,mdim
2590 do f=1,fdim
2591 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l) &
2592 = gfield_p(f,m,l,i)
2593 end do
2594 end do
2595 end do
2596 end do
2597 endif
2598 call mpibarrier(mpicom)
2599#else
2600
2601 ! copy chunked data structure into dynamics field
2602 ! (pgcol ordering chosen to reflect begchunk:endchunk
2603 ! local ordering)
2604 do l=1,ldim
2605!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2606!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2607 do i=1,ngcols_p
2608 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2609 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2610 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2611 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2612 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2613 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2614 do m=1,mdim
2615 do f=1,fdim
2616 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l) &
2617 = localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l)
2618 end do
2619 end do
2620 end do
2621 end do
2622
2623#endif
2624
2625 return
2626 end subroutine gather_chunk_to_field
2627
2628!
2629!========================================================================
2630!
2631 subroutine gather_chunk_to_field4 (fdim,mdim,ldim, &
2632 hdim1d,localchunks,globalfield)
2633
2634!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2635!
2636! Purpose: Reconstruct field
2637! from decomposed chunk data structure
2638!
2639! Method:
2640!
2641! Author: Patrick Worley
2642!
2643!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2644#if ( defined SPMD )
2645 use spmd_utils, only: fc_gathervr4
2646#endif
2647!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
2648 integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! declared length of first dimension
2649 integer, intent(in) :: mdim ! declared length of middle dimension
2650 integer, intent(in) :: ldim ! declared length of last dimension
2651 integer, intent(in) :: hdim1d ! declared first horizontal index
2652 ! dimension
2653 real(r4), intent(in):: localchunks(fdim,pcols,mdim, &
2654 begchunk:endchunk,ldim)
2655 ! local chunks
2656
2657 real(r4), intent(out) :: globalfield(fdim,hdim1d,mdim,hdim2_d,ldim)
2658 ! global field
2659
2660!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
2661 integer :: f,i,m,l,p ! loop indices
2662 integer :: cid ! global chunk id
2663 integer :: lcid ! local chunk id
2664 integer :: lid ! local column index
2665 integer :: gcol ! global column index
2666 integer :: h1 ! first horizontal dimension index
2667 integer :: h2 ! second horizontal dimension index
2668
2669#if ( defined SPMD )
2670 real(r4) gfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,ngcols)
2671 ! vector to be gathered
2672 real(r4) lfield_p(fdim,mdim,ldim,nlcols)
2673 ! local component of gather
2674 ! vector
2675 integer :: displs(0:npes-1) ! gather displacements
2676 integer :: rcvcnts(0:npes-1) ! gather receive count
2677 integer :: sendcnt ! gather send counts
2678 integer :: beglcol ! beginning index for local columns
2679 ! in global column ordering
2680#endif
2681
2682!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2683 if (hdim1d < hdim1_d) then
2684 call endrun ('GATHER_CHUNK_TO_FIELD4 error: hdim1d < hdim1_d')
2685 endif
2686#if ( defined SPMD )
2687 displs(0) = 0
2688 rcvcnts(0) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(0)
2689 beglcol = 0
2690 do p=1,npes-1
2691 displs(p) = displs(p-1) + rcvcnts(p-1)
2692 rcvcnts(p) = fdim*mdim*ldim*gs_col_num(p)
2693 if (p <= iam) then
2694 beglcol = beglcol + gs_col_num(p-1)
2695 endif
2696 enddo
2697 sendcnt = fdim*mdim*ldim*nlcols
2698
2699! copy into local gather data structure
2700
2701 do l=1,ldim
2702!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2703!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2704 do i=1,nlcols
2705 cid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%chunk
2706 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2707 lid = pgcols(beglcol+i)%ccol
2708 do m=1,mdim
2709 do f=1,fdim
2710 lfield_p(f, m, l, i) = &
2711 localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l)
2712 end do
2713 end do
2714 end do
2715 end do
2716
2717! gather from other processes
2718
2719 call t_barrierf('sync_gath_ctof', mpicom)
2720 call fc_gathervr4(lfield_p, sendcnt, mpir4, &
2721 gfield_p, rcvcnts, displs, mpir4, 0, mpicom)
2722
2723 if (masterproc) then
2724
2725! copy gathered columns into lon/lat field
2726
2727!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2728!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2729 do i=1,ngcols_p
2730 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2731 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2732 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2733 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2734 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2735 do l=1,ldim
2736 do m=1,mdim
2737 do f=1,fdim
2738 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l) &
2739 = gfield_p(f,m,l,i)
2740 end do
2741 end do
2742 end do
2743 end do
2744 endif
2745
2746#else
2747
2748! copy chunked data structure into dynamics field
2749! (pgcol ordering chosen to reflect begchunk:endchunk
2750! local ordering)
2751
2752 do l=1,ldim
2753!DIR$ PREFERVECTOR, PREFERSTREAM
2754!DIR$ CONCURRENT
2755 do i=1,ngcols_p
2756 cid = pgcols(i)%chunk
2757 lcid = chunks(cid)%lcid
2758 lid = pgcols(i)%ccol
2759 gcol = chunks(cid)%gcol(lid)
2760 h2 = (gcol-1)/hdim1_d + 1
2761 h1 = mod((gcol-1),hdim1_d) + 1
2762 do m=1,mdim
2763 do f=1,fdim
2764 globalfield(f, h1, m, h2, l) &
2765 = localchunks(f,lid,m,lcid,l)
2766 end do
2767 end do
2768 end do
2769 end do
2770
2771#endif
2772
2773 return
2774 end subroutine gather_chunk_to_field4
2775

30182662426624 subroutine transpose_block_to_chunk(record_size, block_buffer, &
3019 chunk_buffer, window)
3020
3021!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3022!
3023! Purpose: Transpose buffer containing decomposed
3024! fields to buffer
3025! containing decomposed chunk data structures
3026!
3027! Method:
3028!
3029! Author: Patrick Worley
3030! Modified: Art Mirin, Jan 04, to add support for mod_comm
3031!
3032!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3033#if ( defined SPMD )
3034# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3035 use mod_comm, only: blockdescriptor, mp_sendirr, mp_recvirr, &
3036 get_partneroffset, max_nparcels
3037 use mpishorthand, only : mpicom
3038# endif
3039 use spmd_utils, only: altalltoallv
3040#endif
3041!------------------------------Parameters-------------------------------
3042!
3043 integer, parameter :: msgtag = 6000
3044!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3045 integer, intent(in) :: record_size ! per column amount of data
3046 real(r8), intent(in) :: block_buffer(record_size*block_buf_nrecs)
3047 ! buffer of block data to be
3048 ! transposed
3049 real(r8), intent(out):: chunk_buffer(record_size*chunk_buf_nrecs)
3050 ! buffer of chunk data
3051 ! transposed into
3052 integer, intent(in), optional :: window
3053 ! MPI-2 window id for
3054 ! chunk_buffer
3055
3056!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
3057#if ( defined SPMD )
3058 integer :: i, p ! loop indices
3059 integer :: bbuf_siz ! size of block_buffer
3060 integer :: cbuf_siz ! size of chunk_buffer
3061 integer :: lwindow ! placeholder for missing window
3062 integer :: lopt ! local copy of phys_alltoall
3063!
3064 logical, save :: first = .true.
3065 integer, allocatable, save :: sndcnts(:), sdispls(:)
3066 integer, allocatable, save :: rcvcnts(:), rdispls(:)
3067 integer, allocatable, save :: pdispls(:)
3068 integer, save :: prev_record_size = 0
3069# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3070 type (blockdescriptor), allocatable, save :: sendbl(:), recvbl(:)
3071 integer ione, ierror, mod_method
3072# endif
3073!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3074 if (first) then
3075! Compute send/recv/put counts and displacements
30765123072 allocate(sndcnts(0:npes-1))
30775123072 allocate(sdispls(0:npes-1))
30785123072 allocate(rcvcnts(0:npes-1))
30795123072 allocate(rdispls(0:npes-1))
30805123072 allocate(pdispls(0:npes-1))
3081!
3082# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3083! This branch uses mod_comm. Admissable values of phys_alltoall are
3084! 11,12 and 13. Each value corresponds to a different option
3085! within mod_comm of implementing the communication. That option is expressed
3086! internally to mod_comm using the variable mod_method defined below;
3087! mod_method will have values 0,1 or 2 and is defined as
3088! phys_alltoall - modmin_alltoall, where modmin_alltoall equals 11.
3089! Also, sendbl and recvbl must have exactly npes elements, to match
3090! this size of the communicator, or the transpose will fail.
3091!
3092 if (phys_alltoall .ge. modmin_alltoall) then
3093 mod_method = phys_alltoall - modmin_alltoall
3094 ione = 1
3095 allocate( sendbl(0:npes-1) )
3096 allocate( recvbl(0:npes-1) )
3097
3098 do p = 0,npes-1
3099
3100 sendbl(p)%method = mod_method
3101 recvbl(p)%method = mod_method
3102
3103 allocate( sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) )
3104 allocate( sendbl(p)%displacements(1) )
3105 allocate( recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) )
3106 allocate( recvbl(p)%displacements(1) )
3107
3108 enddo
3109
3110 endif
3111# endif
3112
3113512512 first = .false.
3114 endif
3115!
31162662426624 if (record_size .ne. prev_record_size) then
3117!
3118! Compute send/recv/put counts and displacements
3119512512 sdispls(0) = 0
3120 sndcnts(0) = record_size*btofc_blk_num(0)
3121261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
3122 sdispls(p) = sdispls(p-1) + sndcnts(p-1)
3123 sndcnts(p) = record_size*btofc_blk_num(p)
3124 enddo
3125!
3126512512 rdispls(0) = 0
3127 rcvcnts(0) = record_size*btofc_chk_num(0)
3128261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
3129 rdispls(p) = rdispls(p-1) + rcvcnts(p-1)
3130 rcvcnts(p) = record_size*btofc_chk_num(p)
3131 enddo
3132!
3133512512 call mpialltoallint(rdispls, 1, pdispls, 1, mpicom)
3134!
3135# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3136 if (phys_alltoall .ge. modmin_alltoall) then
3137 do p = 0,npes-1
3138
3139 sendbl(p)%type = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL
3140 if ( sndcnts(p) .ne. 0 ) then
3141
3142 if (phys_alltoall .gt. modmin_alltoall) then
3143 call MPI_TYPE_INDEXED(ione, sndcnts(p), &
3144 sdispls(p), mpir8, &
3145 sendbl(p)%type, ierror)
3146 call MPI_TYPE_COMMIT(sendbl(p)%type, ierror)
3147 endif
3148
3149 sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = sndcnts(p)
3150 sendbl(p)%displacements(1) = sdispls(p)
3151 sendbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3152
3153 else
3154
3155 sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = 0
3156 sendbl(p)%displacements(1) = 0
3157 sendbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3158
3159 endif
3160 sendbl(p)%nparcels = size(sendbl(p)%displacements)
3161 sendbl(p)%tot_size = sum(sendbl(p)%blocksizes)
3162 max_nparcels = max(max_nparcels, sendbl(p)%nparcels)
3163
3164 recvbl(p)%type = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL
3165 if ( rcvcnts(p) .ne. 0) then
3166
3167 if (phys_alltoall .gt. modmin_alltoall) then
3168 call MPI_TYPE_INDEXED(ione, rcvcnts(p), &
3169 rdispls(p), mpir8, &
3170 recvbl(p)%type, ierror)
3171 call MPI_TYPE_COMMIT(recvbl(p)%type, ierror)
3172 endif
3173
3174 recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = rcvcnts(p)
3175 recvbl(p)%displacements(1) = rdispls(p)
3176 recvbl(p)%partneroffset = 0 ! not properly initialized - do not use Mpi2
3177 else
3178
3179 recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = 0
3180 recvbl(p)%displacements(1) = 0
3181 recvbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3182
3183 endif
3184 recvbl(p)%nparcels = size(recvbl(p)%displacements)
3185 recvbl(p)%tot_size = sum(recvbl(p)%blocksizes)
3186 max_nparcels = max(max_nparcels, recvbl(p)%nparcels)
3187
3188 enddo
3189
3190 call get_partneroffset(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl)
3191
3192 endif
3193# endif
3194!
3195512512 prev_record_size = record_size
3196 endif
3197!
31982662426624 call t_barrierf('sync_tran_btoc', mpicom)
31992662426624 if (phys_alltoall < 0) then
32002662426624 if ((max_nproc_smpx > npes/2) .and. (nproc_busy_d > npes/2)) then
320100 lopt = 0
3202 else
32032662426624 lopt = 1
3204 endif
3205 else
320600 lopt = phys_alltoall
320700 if ((lopt .eq. 2) .and. ( .not. present(window) )) lopt = 1
3208 endif
32092662426624 if (lopt < 4) then
3210!
32112662426624 bbuf_siz = record_size*block_buf_nrecs
3212 cbuf_siz = record_size*chunk_buf_nrecs
32132662453248 if ( present(window) ) then
321400 call altalltoallv(lopt, iam, npes, &
3215 dp_coup_steps, dp_coup_proc, &
3216 block_buffer, bbuf_siz, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3217 chunk_buffer, cbuf_siz, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3218 msgtag, pdispls, mpir8, window, mpicom)
3219 else
32202662426624 call altalltoallv(lopt, iam, npes, &
3221 dp_coup_steps, dp_coup_proc, &
3222 block_buffer, bbuf_siz, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3223 chunk_buffer, cbuf_siz, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3224 msgtag, pdispls, mpir8, lwindow, mpicom)
3225 endif
3226!
3227 else
3228!
3229# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3230 call mp_sendirr(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl, block_buffer, chunk_buffer)
3231 call mp_recvirr(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl, block_buffer, chunk_buffer)
3232# else
323300 call mpialltoallv(block_buffer, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3234 chunk_buffer, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3235 mpicom)
3236# endif
3237!
3238 endif
3239!
3240#endif
3241 return
32422662426624 end subroutine transpose_block_to_chunk
3243!
3244!========================================================================
3245
32467987279872 subroutine block_to_chunk_send_pters(blockid, fdim, ldim, &
3247 record_size, pter)
3248!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3249!
3250! Purpose: Return pointers into send buffer where column from decomposed
3251! fields should be copied to
3252!
3253! Method:
3254!
3255! Author: Patrick Worley
3256!
3257!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3258!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3259 integer, intent(in) :: blockid ! block index
3260 integer, intent(in) :: fdim ! first dimension of pter array
3261 integer, intent(in) :: ldim ! last dimension of pter array
3262 integer, intent(in) :: record_size ! per coordinate amount of data
3263
3264 integer, intent(out) :: pter(fdim,ldim) ! buffer offsets
3265!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
3266 integer :: i, k ! loop indices
3267!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
32687987279872 if ((btofc_blk_offset(blockid)%ncols > fdim) .or. &
3269 (btofc_blk_offset(blockid)%nlvls > ldim)) then
327000 write(iulog,*) "BLOCK_TO_CHUNK_SEND_PTERS: pter array dimensions ", &
3271 "not large enough: (",fdim,",",ldim,") not >= (", &
3272 btofc_blk_offset(blockid)%ncols,",", &

327400 call endrun()

32782228751224763544 do i=1,btofc_blk_offset(blockid)%ncols

33502611226112 subroutine transpose_chunk_to_block(record_size, chunk_buffer, &
3351 block_buffer, window)
3352!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3353!
3354! Purpose: Transpose buffer containing decomposed
3355! chunk data structures to buffer
3356! containing decomposed fields
3357!
3358! Method:
3359!
3360! Author: Patrick Worley
3361!
3362!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3363#if ( defined SPMD )
3364# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3365 use mod_comm, only: blockdescriptor, mp_sendirr, mp_recvirr, &
3366 get_partneroffset, max_nparcels
3367 use mpishorthand, only : mpicom
3368# endif
3369 use spmd_utils, only: altalltoallv
3370#endif
3371!------------------------------Parameters-------------------------------
3372!
3373 integer, parameter :: msgtag = 7000
3374!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3375 integer, intent(in) :: record_size ! per column amount of data
3376 real(r8), intent(inout):: chunk_buffer(record_size*chunk_buf_nrecs)
3377 ! buffer of chunk data to be
3378 ! transposed
3379 real(r8), intent(out) :: block_buffer(record_size*block_buf_nrecs)
3380 ! buffer of block data to
3381 ! transpose into
3382 integer, intent(in), optional :: window
3383 ! MPI-2 window id for
3384 ! chunk_buffer
3385
3386!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
3387#if ( defined SPMD )
3388 integer :: i, p ! loop indices
3389 integer :: bbuf_siz ! size of block_buffer
3390 integer :: cbuf_siz ! size of chunk_buffer
3391 integer :: lwindow ! placeholder for missing window
3392 integer :: lopt ! local copy of phys_alltoall
3393!
3394 logical, save :: first = .true.
3395 integer, allocatable, save :: sndcnts(:), sdispls(:)
3396 integer, allocatable, save :: rcvcnts(:), rdispls(:)
3397 integer, allocatable, save :: pdispls(:)
3398 integer, save :: prev_record_size = 0
3399# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3400 type (blockdescriptor), allocatable, save :: sendbl(:), recvbl(:)
3401 integer ione, ierror, mod_method
3402# endif
3403!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3404 if (first) then
3405! Compute send/recv/put counts and displacements
34065123072 allocate(sndcnts(0:npes-1))
34075123072 allocate(sdispls(0:npes-1))
34085123072 allocate(rcvcnts(0:npes-1))
34095123072 allocate(rdispls(0:npes-1))
34105123072 allocate(pdispls(0:npes-1))
3411!
3412# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3413! This branch uses mod_comm. Admissable values of phys_alltoall are
3414! 11,12 and 13. Each value corresponds to a differerent option
3415! within mod_comm of implementing the communication. That option is expressed
3416! internally to mod_comm using the variable mod_method defined below;
3417! mod_method will have values 0,1 or 2 and is defined as
3418! phys_alltoall - modmin_alltoall, where modmin_alltoall equals 11.
3419! Also, sendbl and recvbl must have exactly npes elements, to match
3420! this size of the communicator, or the transpose will fail.
3421!
3422 if (phys_alltoall .ge. modmin_alltoall) then
3423 mod_method = phys_alltoall - modmin_alltoall
3424 ione = 1
3425 allocate( sendbl(0:npes-1) )
3426 allocate( recvbl(0:npes-1) )
3427
3428 do p = 0,npes-1
3429
3430 sendbl(p)%method = mod_method
3431 recvbl(p)%method = mod_method
3432
3433 allocate( sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) )
3434 allocate( sendbl(p)%displacements(1) )
3435 allocate( recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) )
3436 allocate( recvbl(p)%displacements(1) )
3437
3438 enddo
3439
3440 endif
3441# endif
3442!
3443512512 first = .false.
3444 endif
3445!
34462611226112 if (record_size .ne. prev_record_size) then
3447!
3448! Compute send/recv/put counts and displacements
3449512512 sdispls(0) = 0
3450 sndcnts(0) = record_size*btofc_chk_num(0)
3451261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
3452 sdispls(p) = sdispls(p-1) + sndcnts(p-1)
3453 sndcnts(p) = record_size*btofc_chk_num(p)
3454 enddo
3455!
3456512512 rdispls(0) = 0
3457 rcvcnts(0) = record_size*btofc_blk_num(0)
3458261632261632 do p=1,npes-1
3459 rdispls(p) = rdispls(p-1) + rcvcnts(p-1)
3460 rcvcnts(p) = record_size*btofc_blk_num(p)
3461 enddo
3462!
3463512512 call mpialltoallint(rdispls, 1, pdispls, 1, mpicom)
3464!
3465# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3466 if (phys_alltoall .ge. modmin_alltoall) then
3467 do p = 0,npes-1
3468
3469 sendbl(p)%type = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL
3470 if ( sndcnts(p) .ne. 0 ) then
3471
3472 if (phys_alltoall .gt. modmin_alltoall) then
3473 call MPI_TYPE_INDEXED(ione, sndcnts(p), &
3474 sdispls(p), mpir8, &
3475 sendbl(p)%type, ierror)
3476 call MPI_TYPE_COMMIT(sendbl(p)%type, ierror)
3477 endif
3478
3479 sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = sndcnts(p)
3480 sendbl(p)%displacements(1) = sdispls(p)
3481 sendbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3482
3483 else
3484
3485 sendbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = 0
3486 sendbl(p)%displacements(1) = 0
3487 sendbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3488
3489 endif
3490 sendbl(p)%nparcels = size(sendbl(p)%displacements)
3491 sendbl(p)%tot_size = sum(sendbl(p)%blocksizes)
3492 max_nparcels = max(max_nparcels, sendbl(p)%nparcels)
3493
3494 recvbl(p)%type = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL
3495 if ( rcvcnts(p) .ne. 0) then
3496
3497 if (phys_alltoall .gt. modmin_alltoall) then
3498 call MPI_TYPE_INDEXED(ione, rcvcnts(p), &
3499 rdispls(p), mpir8, &
3500 recvbl(p)%type, ierror)
3501 call MPI_TYPE_COMMIT(recvbl(p)%type, ierror)
3502 endif
3503
3504 recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = rcvcnts(p)
3505 recvbl(p)%displacements(1) = rdispls(p)
3506 recvbl(p)%partneroffset = 0 ! not properly initialized - do not use Mpi2
3507 else
3508
3509 recvbl(p)%blocksizes(1) = 0
3510 recvbl(p)%displacements(1) = 0
3511 recvbl(p)%partneroffset = 0
3512
3513 endif
3514 recvbl(p)%nparcels = size(recvbl(p)%displacements)
3515 recvbl(p)%tot_size = sum(recvbl(p)%blocksizes)
3516 max_nparcels = max(max_nparcels, recvbl(p)%nparcels)
3517
3518 enddo
3519
3520 call get_partneroffset(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl)
3521
3522 endif
3523# endif
3524!
3525512512 prev_record_size = record_size
3526 endif
3527!
35282611226112 call t_barrierf('sync_tran_ctob', mpicom)
35292611226112 if (phys_alltoall < 0) then
35302611226112 if ((max_nproc_smpx > npes/2) .and. (nproc_busy_d > npes/2)) then
353100 lopt = 0
3532 else
35332611226112 lopt = 1
3534 endif
3535 else
353600 lopt = phys_alltoall
353700 if ((lopt .eq. 2) .and. ( .not. present(window) )) lopt = 1
3538 endif
35392611226112 if (lopt < 4) then
3540!
35412611226112 bbuf_siz = record_size*block_buf_nrecs
3542 cbuf_siz = record_size*chunk_buf_nrecs
35432611252224 if ( present(window) ) then
354400 call altalltoallv(lopt, iam, npes, &
3545 dp_coup_steps, dp_coup_proc, &
3546 chunk_buffer, cbuf_siz, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3547 block_buffer, bbuf_siz, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3548 msgtag, pdispls, mpir8, window, mpicom)
3549 else
35502611226112 call altalltoallv(lopt, iam, npes, &
3551 dp_coup_steps, dp_coup_proc, &
3552 chunk_buffer, cbuf_siz, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3553 block_buffer, bbuf_siz, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3554 msgtag, pdispls, mpir8, lwindow, mpicom)
3555 endif
3556!
3557 else
3558# if defined(MODCM_DP_TRANSPOSE)
3559 call mp_sendirr(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl, block_buffer, chunk_buffer)
3560 call mp_recvirr(mpicom, sendbl, recvbl, block_buffer, chunk_buffer)
3561# else
356200 call mpialltoallv(chunk_buffer, sndcnts, sdispls, mpir8, &
3563 block_buffer, rcvcnts, rdispls, mpir8, &
3564 mpicom)
3565# endif
3566!
3567 endif
3568!
3569#endif
3570
3571 return
35722611226112 end subroutine transpose_chunk_to_block
3573!
3574!========================================================================
3575

36805121024 subroutine create_chunks(opt, chunks_per_thread)
3681!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3682!
3683! Purpose: Decompose physics computational grid into chunks, for
3684! improved serial efficiency and parallel load balance.
3685!
3686! Method:
3687!
3688! Author: Patrick Worley
3689!
3690!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3691 use pmgrid, only: plev
3692 use dyn_grid, only: get_block_bounds_d, get_block_gcol_cnt_d, &
3693 get_gcol_block_cnt_d, get_gcol_block_d, &
3694 get_block_owner_d, get_block_gcol_d
3695!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3696 integer, intent(in) :: opt ! chunking option
3697 ! 0: chunks may cross block boundaries, but retain same
3698 ! process mapping as blocks. If possible, columns assigned
3699 ! as day/night pairs. Columns (or pairs) are wrap-mapped.
3700 ! May not work with vertically decomposed blocks. (default)
3701 ! 1: chunks may cross block boundaries, but retain same
3702 ! SMP-node mapping as blocks. If possible, columns assigned
3703 ! as day/night pairs. Columns (or pairs) are wrap-mapped.
3704 ! May not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
3705 ! 2: 2-column day/night and season column pairs wrap-mapped
3706 ! to chunks to also balance assignment of polar, mid-latitude,
3707 ! and equatorial columns across chunks.
3708 ! 3: same as 1 except that SMP defined to be pairs of consecutive
3709 ! processes
3710 ! 4: chunks may cross block boundaries, but retain same
3711 ! process mapping as blocks. Columns assigned to chunks
3712 ! in block ordering.
3713 ! May not work with vertically decomposed blocks.
3714 ! 5: Chunks do not cross latitude boundaries, and are block-mapped.
3715 integer, intent(in) :: chunks_per_thread
3716 ! target number of chunks per
3717 ! thread
3718!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
3719 integer :: i, j, p ! loop indices
3720 integer :: nlthreads ! number of local OpenMP threads
3721 integer :: npthreads(0:npes-1) ! number of OpenMP threads per process
3722 integer :: proc_smp_mapx(0:npes-1) ! process/virtual SMP node map
3723 integer :: firstblock, lastblock ! global block index bounds
3724 integer :: maxblksiz ! maximum number of columns in a dynamics block
3725 integer :: block_cnt ! number of blocks containing data
3726 ! for a given vertical column
3727 integer :: blockids(plev+1) ! block indices
3728 integer :: bcids(plev+1) ! block column indices
3729 integer :: nsmpx, nsmpy ! virtual SMP node counts and indices
3730 integer :: curgcol, twingcol ! global physics and dynamics column indices
3731 integer :: smp ! SMP node index
3732 integer :: cid ! chunk id
3733 integer :: jb, ib ! global block and columns indices
3734 integer :: blksiz ! current block size
3735 integer :: ntmp1, ntmp2, nlchunks ! work variables
3736 integer :: cbeg ! beginning longitude index for
3737 ! current chunk
3738 integer :: max_ncols ! upper bound on number of columns in a block
3739 integer :: ncols ! number of columns in current chunk
3740 logical :: error ! error flag
3741
3742 ! indices for dynamics columns in given block
3743 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: cols
3744
3745 ! number of MPI processes per virtual SMP node (0:nsmpx-1)
3746 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: nsmpprocs
3747
3748 ! flag indicating whether a process is busy or idle during the dynamics (0:npes-1)
3749 logical, dimension(:), allocatable :: proc_busy_d
3750
3751 ! flag indicating whether any of the processes assigned to an SMP node are busy
3752 ! during the dynamics, or whether all of them are idle (0:nsmps-1)
3753 logical, dimension(:), allocatable :: smp_busy_d
3754
3755 ! actual SMP node/virtual SMP node map (0:nsmps-1)
3756 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: smp_smp_mapx
3757
3758 ! column/virtual SMP node map (ngcols)
3759 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: col_smp_mapx
3760
3761 ! number of columns assigned to a given virtual SMP node (0:nsmpx-1)
3762 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: nsmpcolumns
3763
3764 ! number of OpenMP threads per virtual SMP node (0:nsmpx-1)
3765 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: nsmpthreads
3766
3767 ! number of chunks assigned to a given virtual SMP node (0:nsmpx-1)
3768 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: nsmpchunks
3769
3770 ! maximum number of columns assigned to a chunk in a given virtual SMP node (0:nsmpx-1)
3771 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: maxcol_chk
3772
3773 ! number of chunks in given virtual SMP node receiving maximum number of columns
3774 ! (0:nsmpx-1)
3775 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: maxcol_chks
3776
3777 ! chunk id virtual offset (0:nsmpx-1)
3778 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: cid_offset
3779
3780 ! process-local chunk id (0:nsmpx-1)
3781 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: local_cid
3782
3783#if ( defined _OPENMP )
3784 integer omp_get_max_threads
3785 external omp_get_max_threads
3786#endif
3787
3788!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3789!
3790! Determine number of threads per process
3791!
3792 nlthreads = 1
3793#if ( defined _OPENMP )
3794 nlthreads = OMP_GET_MAX_THREADS()
3795#endif
3796!
3797#if ( defined SPMD )
3798512512 call mpiallgatherint(nlthreads, 1, npthreads, 1, mpicom)
3799#else
3800 npthreads(0) = nlthreads
3801 proc_smp_map(0) = 0
3802#endif
3803
3804!
3805! Determine index range for dynamics blocks
3806!
3807512512 call get_block_bounds_d(firstblock,lastblock)
3808
3809!
3810! Determine maximum number of columns in a block
3811!
3812512512 maxblksiz = 0
3813786432786432 do jb=firstblock,lastblock
3814786432786432 maxblksiz = max(maxblksiz,get_block_gcol_cnt_d(jb))
3815 enddo
3816
3817!
3818! determine which (and how many) processes are assigned
3819! dynamics blocks
3820!
38215123072 allocate( proc_busy_d(0:npes-1) )
3822262144263168 proc_busy_d = .false.
3823512512 nproc_busy_d = 0
3824786432786432 do jb=firstblock,lastblock
38257864321572864 p = get_block_owner_d(jb)
3826 if (.not. proc_busy_d(p) ) then
3827262144262144 proc_busy_d(p) = .true.
3828 nproc_busy_d = nproc_busy_d + 1
3829 endif
3830 enddo
3831
3832!
3833! Determine virtual SMP count and processes/virtual SMP map.
3834! If option 0 or >3, pretend that each SMP has only one process.
3835! If option 1, use SMP information.
3836! If option 2, pretend that all processes are in one SMP node.
3837! If option 3, pretend that each SMP node is made up of two
3838! processes, chosen to maximize load-balancing opportunities.
3839!
3840! For all options < 5, if there are "idle" dynamics processes,
3841! assign them to the virtual SMP nodes in wrap fashion.
3842! Communication between the active and idle dynamics
3843! processes is scatter/gather (no communications between
3844! idle dynamics processes) so there is no advantage to
3845! blocking the idle processes in these assignments.
3846!
38475121024 if ((opt <= 0) .or. (opt == 4)) then
3848
3849! assign active dynamics processes to virtual SMP nodes
385000 nsmpx = 0
385100 do p=0,npes-1
385200 if (proc_busy_d(p)) then
385300 proc_smp_mapx(p) = nsmpx
3854 nsmpx = nsmpx + 1
3855 endif
3856 enddo
3857!
3858! assign idle dynamics processes to virtual SMP nodes (wrap map)
385900 nsmpy = 0
386000 do p=0,npes-1
386100 if (.not. proc_busy_d(p)) then
386200 proc_smp_mapx(p) = nsmpy
3863 nsmpy = mod(nsmpy+1,nsmpx)
3864 endif
3865 enddo
3866
3867 elseif (opt == 1) then
3868
38695123072 allocate( smp_busy_d(0:nsmps-1) )

3871
3872!
3873! determine SMP nodes assigned dynamics blocks

3876262144262144 if ( proc_busy_d(p) ) then
3877262144262144 smp = proc_smp_map(p)
3878 smp_busy_d(smp) = .true.
3879 endif
3880 enddo
3881

388720482048 smp_smp_mapx(smp) = nsmpx
3888 nsmpx = nsmpx + 1
3889 endif
3890 enddo

3893262144262656 do p=0,npes-1
3894262144262144 smp = proc_smp_map(p)
3895 if (smp_busy_d(smp)) then
3896262144262144 proc_smp_mapx(p) = smp_smp_mapx(smp)
3897 endif
3898 enddo
3899!

3902262144262144 do p=0,npes-1
3903262144262144 smp = proc_smp_map(p)
3904 if (.not. smp_busy_d(smp)) then
390500 proc_smp_mapx(p) = nsmpy
3906 nsmpy = mod(nsmpy+1,nsmpx)

3925!

393100 proc_smp_mapx(p) = nsmpy

3942

397170789127078912 curgcol = latlon_to_dyn_gcol_map(i)
3972707891214157824 block_cnt = get_gcol_block_cnt_d(curgcol)
397370789127078912 call get_gcol_block_d(curgcol,block_cnt,blockids,bcids)
3974707891214157824 do jb=1,block_cnt

3976 if (col_smp_mapx(i) .eq. -1) then

397800 elseif (col_smp_mapx(i) .ne. proc_smp_mapx(p)) then

4009!
4010! Options 0-3: split local dynamics blocks into chunks,
4011! using wrap-map assignment of columns and
4012! day/night and north/south column pairs
4013! to chunks to improve load balance
4014! Option 0: local is per process
4015! Option 1: local is subset of`processes assigned to same SMP node
4016! Option 2: local is global
4017! Option 3: local is pair of processes chosen to maximize load-balance
4018! wrt restriction that only communicate with one other
4019! process.
4020! Option 4: split local dynamics blocks into chunks,

4023512512 if ((opt >= 0) .and. (opt <= 4)) then

4029 smp = proc_smp_mapx(p)

4038 if (mod(nsmpcolumns(smp), pcols) .ne. 0) then

404120482048 if (nsmpchunks(smp) < chunks_per_thread*nsmpthreads(smp)) then
4042 nsmpchunks(smp) = chunks_per_thread*nsmpthreads(smp)

40448089682944 do while (mod(nsmpchunks(smp), nsmpthreads(smp)) .ne. 0)
4045 nsmpchunks(smp) = nsmpchunks(smp) + 1
4046 enddo
4047 if (nsmpchunks(smp) > nsmpcolumns(smp)) then
4048 nsmpchunks(smp) = nsmpcolumns(smp)
4049 endif
4050 nchunks = nchunks + nsmpchunks(smp)

405620482560 do smp=0,nsmpx-1

405820482048 ntmp1 = nsmpcolumns(smp)/nsmpchunks(smp)

406120482048 maxcol_chk(smp) = ntmp1 + 1
4062 maxcol_chks(smp) = ntmp2
4063 else
406400 maxcol_chk(smp) = ntmp1
4065 maxcol_chks(smp) = nsmpchunks(smp)
4066 endif
4067 else
406800 maxcol_chk(smp) = 0
4069 maxcol_chks(smp) = 0

4072!

40755123072 allocate( chunks(1:nchunks) )

4079!
4080524288525312 chunks(:)%ncols = 0
408170789127079936 knuhcs(:)%chunkid = -1
408270789127079936 knuhcs(:)%col = -1
4083!
4084! Determine chunk id ranges for each SMP
4085!
4086512512 cid_offset(0) = 1
4087 local_cid(0) = 0
408815361536 do smp=1,nsmpx-1
4089 cid_offset(smp) = cid_offset(smp-1) + nsmpchunks(smp-1)
4090 local_cid(smp) = 0
4091 enddo
4092!
4093! Assign columns to chunks
4094!
4095786432786944 do jb=firstblock,lastblock
40967864321572864 p = get_block_owner_d(jb)
4097 smp = proc_smp_mapx(p)
40987864321572864 blksiz = get_block_gcol_cnt_d(jb)
4099786432786432 call get_block_gcol_d(jb,blksiz,cols)
410070789127865344 do ib = 1,blksiz
4101!
4102! Assign column to a chunk if not already assigned
410370789127078912 curgcol = cols(ib)
410470789127078912 if ((dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(curgcol) .ne. -1) .and. &
4105 (knuhcs(curgcol)%chunkid == -1)) then
4106!
4107! Find next chunk with space
4108! (maxcol_chks > 0 test necessary for opt=4 block map)
410970789127078912 cid = cid_offset(smp) + local_cid(smp)
4110 if (maxcol_chks(smp) > 0) then
411170789127078912 do while (chunks(cid)%ncols >= maxcol_chk(smp))
4112 local_cid(smp) = mod(local_cid(smp)+1,nsmpchunks(smp))
4113 cid = cid_offset(smp) + local_cid(smp)
4114 enddo
4115 else
411600 do while (chunks(cid)%ncols >= maxcol_chk(smp)-1)
4117 local_cid(smp) = mod(local_cid(smp)+1,nsmpchunks(smp))
4118 cid = cid_offset(smp) + local_cid(smp)
4119 enddo
4120 endif
412170789127078912 chunks(cid)%ncols = chunks(cid)%ncols + 1
4122 if (chunks(cid)%ncols .eq. maxcol_chk(smp)) &
4123263168263168 maxcol_chks(smp) = maxcol_chks(smp) - 1
4124!
412570789127078912 i = chunks(cid)%ncols
4126 chunks(cid)%gcol(i) = curgcol
4127 chunks(cid)%lon(i) = lon_p(curgcol)
4128 chunks(cid)%lat(i) = lat_p(curgcol)
4129 knuhcs(curgcol)%chunkid = cid
4130 knuhcs(curgcol)%col = i
4131!
4132 if (opt < 4) then
4133!
4134! If space available, look to assign a load-balancing "twin" to same chunk
4135707891220710400 if ( (chunks(cid)%ncols < maxcol_chk(smp)) .and. &
4136 (maxcol_chks(smp) > 0) .and. (twin_alg > 0)) then
4137
413800 call find_twin(curgcol, smp, &
4139 proc_smp_mapx, twingcol)
4140
414100 if (twingcol > 0) then
414200 chunks(cid)%ncols = chunks(cid)%ncols + 1
4143 if (chunks(cid)%ncols .eq. maxcol_chk(smp)) &
414400 maxcol_chks(smp) = maxcol_chks(smp) - 1
4145!
414600 i = chunks(cid)%ncols
4147 chunks(cid)%gcol(i) = twingcol
4148 chunks(cid)%lon(i) = lon_p(twingcol)
4149 chunks(cid)%lat(i) = lat_p(twingcol)
4150 knuhcs(twingcol)%chunkid = cid
4151 knuhcs(twingcol)%col = i
4152 endif
4153!
4154 endif
4155!
4156! Move on to next chunk (wrap map)
415770789127078912 local_cid(smp) = mod(local_cid(smp)+1,nsmpchunks(smp))
4158!
4159 endif
4160!
4161 endif
4162 enddo
4163 enddo
4164!
4165 else
4166!
4167! Option 5: split individual dynamics blocks into chunks,
4168! assigning consecutive columns to the same chunk
4169!
4170! Determine total number of chunks and
4171! number of chunks in each "SMP node"
4172! (assuming no vertical decomposition)
417300 nchunks = 0
417400 nsmpchunks(:) = 0
417500 do j=firstblock,lastblock
417600 blksiz = get_block_gcol_cnt_d(j)
4177 nlchunks = blksiz/pcols
4178 if (pcols*(blksiz/pcols) /= blksiz) then
417900 nlchunks = nlchunks + 1
4180 endif
418100 nchunks = nchunks + nlchunks
418200 p = get_block_owner_d(j)
4183 nsmpchunks(p) = nsmpchunks(p) + nlchunks
4184 enddo
4185!
4186! Determine chunk id ranges for each SMP
4187!
418800 cid_offset(0) = 1
4189 local_cid(0) = 0
419000 do smp=1,nsmpx-1
4191 cid_offset(smp) = cid_offset(smp-1) + nsmpchunks(smp-1)
4192 local_cid(smp) = 0
4193 enddo
4194!
4195! Allocate chunks and knuhcs data structures
4196!
419700 allocate( chunks(1:nchunks) )
419800 allocate( knuhcs(1:ngcols) )
4199!
4200! Initialize chunks and knuhcs data structures
4201!
420200 knuhcs(:)%chunkid = -1
420300 knuhcs(:)%col = -1
420400 cid = 0
420500 do jb=firstblock,lastblock
420600 p = get_block_owner_d(jb)
4207 smp = proc_smp_mapx(p)
420800 blksiz = get_block_gcol_cnt_d(jb)
420900 call get_block_gcol_d(jb,blksiz,cols)
4210
421100 ib = 0
421200 do while (ib < blksiz)
4213
421400 cid = cid_offset(smp) + local_cid(smp)
4215 max_ncols = min(pcols,blksiz-ib)
4216
4217 ncols = 0
421800 do i=1,max_ncols
421900 ib = ib + 1
4220 ! check whether global index is for a column that dynamics
4221 ! intends to pass to the physics
4222 curgcol = cols(ib)
4223 if (dyn_to_latlon_gcol_map(curgcol) .ne. -1) then
4224 ! yes - then save the information
422500 ncols = ncols + 1
4226 chunks(cid)%gcol(ncols) = curgcol
4227 chunks(cid)%lon(ncols) = lon_p(curgcol)
4228 chunks(cid)%lat(ncols) = lat_p(curgcol)
4229 knuhcs(curgcol)%chunkid = cid
4230 knuhcs(curgcol)%col = ncols
4231 endif
4232 enddo
4233 chunks(cid)%ncols = ncols
4234
4235 local_cid(smp) = local_cid(smp) + 1
4236 enddo
4237 enddo
4238!
4239! Set number of threads available in each "SMP node".
4240!
424100 do p=0,npes-1
4242 nsmpthreads(p) = npthreads(p)
4243 enddo
4244!
4245 endif
4246!
4247! Assign chunks to processes.
4248!
4249512512 call assign_chunks(npthreads, nsmpx, proc_smp_mapx, &
4250 nsmpthreads, nsmpchunks)
4251!
